name: Hardcoded credential assignment
message: A credential appears to be written into the source. Read it from the environment or a secret manager, and rotate the value that was committed. If this is not a secret, mark the line with 'harness-ignore: SEC-010'.

name: Provider-issued token
message: This matches the issued shape of a GitHub, AWS, OpenAI, Slack or Google credential. Revoke it at the provider before anything else: it is valid until you do, and it is now in the repository's history.

name: Credentials embedded in a URL or DSN
message: A connection string carries a username and password inline. Move the credential to the environment and reference it, so the DSN can be logged without leaking it.

name: Private key block
message: A PEM private key is committed as file content. Remove it, rotate the key pair, and keep key material in a secret manager. SEC-003 catches it by filename; this catches it wherever it was pasted.
